calls.title: 30 min with Scott (Alyssa Nicoll)
calls.summary: The meeting discussed the significant evolution of the DevRel role at Growth Book, transitioning to a multi-marketer position addressing enterprise sales and community engagement. With an emphasis on integrating core DevRel tasks within a broader organizational framework, challenges were identified in effectively engaging diverse user communities. The discussion highlighted the importance of creating user-generated content and maintaining developer trust while navigating complex product needs, particularly in feature flagging, experimentation, and analytics. Plans for a managed ClickHouse warehouse were outlined to enhance onboarding processes, aligning with Growth Book's focus on product-led growth while balancing existing enterprise customer requirements.
calls.keywords: Developer Advocate, Product Marketing, Feature Flagging, Community Engagement, Managed Data Warehouse, Developer Tools
